answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 30 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in mirror, queued in lagoon, and lantern publishes the wait time. A farm of 233 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3965 identities would post 4141 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
